Background / Context

This project involves the development of "Homeland," an open-source discussion platform built using Ruby on Rails. The platform serves as a full-stack forum application and is designed to provide users with an efficient and user-friendly discussion experience. It integrates social networking features, real-time notifications, and supports responsive design to accommodate various devices.

 Objectives

The primary goal of Homeland is to offer a robust platform for online discussions. It aims to facilitate user interaction through features like topic following, notifications, and content mention. Additionally, it seeks to enable secure deployment and integration with other systems via Single Sign-On (SSO) and public APIs.

 Stakeholders & Users

- Administrators: Manage content, users, and system settings.
- End Users: Participate in discussions, follow topics, and engage with content.
- Developers: Use the public API for building applications.
- System Integrators: Implement SSO for seamless integration with other systems.

 Functional Descriptions

1. Forum Capabilities:
   - Users can create, reply to, and follow topics.
   - Real-time notifications keep users updated on activity.
   - Topics and posts can be formatted using Markdown.
   - Users can mention others using a syntax similar to Twitter.

2. Responsive Design:
   - The platform is accessible on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
   - Layout adjusts automatically to different screen sizes.

3. Social Networking Integration:
   - Users can follow other users and specific topics.
   - Supports Twemoji and system emojis for engagement.

4. Security and SSO:
   - Automated free SSL integration for secure access via HTTPS.
   - Supports SSO as both provider and consumer for account synchronization across systems.

5. Public API:
   - Provides an API for developing mobile applications and integrating with other services.

 Non-Functional Descriptions

- Performance: Quick response times for page loading and user interactions.
- Scalability: Efficiently handle a large number of users and discussions.
- Security: Data encryption and secure authentication mechanisms.
- Usability: Intuitive user interface with an emphasis on ease of use for all functionalities.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0070
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password_digest` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `display_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_users_on_username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_users_on_email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `topics` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `posts_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `followers_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_topics_on_slug` (`slug`),
  KEY `index_topics_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `topics_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `posts` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `topic_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `parent_post_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `markdown_body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `mentions_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `index_posts_on_topic_id` (`topic_id`),
  KEY `index_posts_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `index_posts_on_parent_post_id` (`parent_post_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`topic_id`) REFERENCES `topics` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_post_id`) REFERENCES `posts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `topic_follows` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `topic_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_topic_follows_on_user_id_and_topic_id` (`user_id`,`topic_id`),
  KEY `index_topic_follows_on_topic_id` (`topic_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `topic_follows_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `topic_follows_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`topic_id`) REFERENCES `topics` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `user_follows` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `follower_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `followed_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_user_follows_on_follower_id_and_followed_id` (`follower_id`,`followed_id`),
  KEY `index_user_follows_on_followed_id` (`followed_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_follows_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`follower_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_follows_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`followed_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `notifications` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `actor_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `topic_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `post_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `notification_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `index_notifications_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `index_notifications_on_actor_id` (`actor_id`),
  KEY `index_notifications_on_topic_id` (`topic_id`),
  KEY `index_notifications_on_post_id` (`post_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `notifications_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `notifications_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `notifications_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`topic_id`) REFERENCES `topics` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `notifications_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `posts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `mentions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `post_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `mentioned_user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_mentions_on_post_id_and_mentioned_user_id` (`post_id`,`mentioned_user_id`),
  KEY `index_mentions_on_mentioned_user_id` (`mentioned_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mentions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `posts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `mentions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`mentioned_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `sso_providers` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `issuer` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `sso_url` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `certificate` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_sso_providers_on_name` (`name`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_sso_providers_on_issuer` (`issuer`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
CREATE TABLE `api_tokens` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `token` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_used_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `index_api_tokens_on_token` (`token`),
  KEY `index_api_tokens_on_user_id` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `api_tokens_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
